subject: chemistry
content: The vapour pressure of a dilute aqueous solution of glucose (C<sub>6</sub>H<sub>12</sub>O<sub>6</sub>) is 750 mm of mercury at 373 K. Calculate (i) molality, and (ii) mole fraction of the solution.
